item.text:
I've updated the `consume_stock` function to validate all requests before modifying the stock. The function now:

- Raises a `KeyError` if an item in the request is not present in the stock.
- Raises a `ValueError` if a request has a negative quantity or if there isn't enough stock for an item.
- Deducts quantities from the stock only if all requests are valid.
- Returns the same stock object after successfully processing all requests.

The changes ensure that the stock remains unchanged in case of any validation failures.
